evidence.note: Explored IF-specific datasets (personas-IF) and data builders before committing to a data mix — a deliberate up-front lever choice, though only one mix was ever used.

Evaluated the single SFT run's checkpoints at successive steps (40/80/160/200/280/320/360/400), tracking how IFEval score moved along the training curve — evidence-gathering that could drive adaptation.

Detected that step-280 was the peak and later checkpoints (320/360/400) did not improve (implicit overtraining signal), then re-evaluated step-280 as final best — an epoch/training-duration lever adjustment on eval evidence, but within one run.
Only a single training run was ever launched; no second run with revised LR, data mix, or method (no SFT→RL pivot), so no cross-run diagnosis-driven revision is observed.

reasoning: The agent responded to eval evidence by selecting the best checkpoint along one training run's curve (effectively tuning the epochs/training-duration lever) and re-testing, matching anchor 5. It did not exhibit anchor-8 behavior — there was no diagnosis of an underperforming run followed by a targeted change of data/LR/method across runs, because the single SFT recipe was never falsified. The within-run overtraining detection and best-checkpoint preservation keep it clearly above the random/superstitious anchor 3, but the absence of any genuine approach revision or method pivot holds it at 5.
